items.name: Race the Clock MN 2025
items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d783e6bc8ef9637fd7108a6fcfdc60829bd500da/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

In addition to the regular events, we will also be holding an unofficial event called "2-Man Mini Guildford"! 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTExODM5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d652984341137594baeceead70ac0bbc291fb5ab/EVENT%20ICONS%20(1).png)

items.name: Maine PBQ 2025
items.information:
**This is not a competition for those faint at heart.  Newcomers are encouraged to find nearby competitions that will hold more basic cubing events.  **


![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

* [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

Students & Staff of MSAD 54 can compete in this competition free of charge.  After you have registered, please use your district-issued email address to email Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org.  After confirming relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted.  All other registration requirements remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).
